grades: High school track: rising 9th graders through college freshmen
name: Summer Film Academy (Light House Studio)
what_you_do: Make your own short film in a one or two week workshop, such as filmmaking, screenwriting, animation or comedy. Workshops run 9am to 3pm.
who_can_apply: Open to all. The high school track is for rising 9th graders through college freshmen. Tuition help is offered. The site also runs free workshops for under-resourced youth (KEEP it Reel).
pay_detail: Tuition not stated on the page read. Tuition assistance is available, reviewed case by case and first come first served.
duration: 1 to 2 weeks, 9am to 3pm (2026 listed dates June 1 to Aug 7)
deadline_text: 2026 workshops listed June 1 to Aug 7. 2027 schedule not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a workshop in the online store (first-time users make an Amilia account). Ask for tuition assistance with the online form. Email programs@lighthousestudio.org or call 434-293-6992.
notes: Light House also lists a Careers page, an Adrenaline Film Project (Nov 5 to 8, 2026) and a Youth Film Festival. Those were not read in detail.
